chunks.arabic_text: اَلْكَافِي: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ فَضَالٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارً، أَنَّهُ حَضَرَ أَحَدَ ابْنَيْ سَابُورً وَكَانَ لَهُمَا فَضْلٌ وَوَرَعٌ وَإِخْبَاتٌ فَمَرِضَ أَحَدُهُمَا وَمَا أَحْسِبُهُ إِلَّا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ سَابُورً قَالَ

translations.en: Al-Kafi: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Fadhal, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, that he visited one of the sons of Sabur, and they possessed merit, self-restraint, and humility; one of them fell ill, and I do not think it was anyone other than Zakariyya ibn Sabur, he said:

chunks.arabic_text: فَحَضَرْتُهُ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ فَبَسَطَ يَدَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ: اِبْيَضَّتْ يَدِي يَا عَلِيٌّ، قَالَ: فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَهُوَ عِنْدَهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْعُونَ قَالَ: فَلَمَّا قُمْتُ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا يُخْبِرُهُ بِخَبَرِ الرَّجُلِ فَأَتْبَعَنِي بِرَسُولٍ فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ: أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ هَذَا الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي حَضَرْتَهُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ سَمِعْتَهُ يَقُولُ؟ قُلْتُ: بَسَطَ يَدَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ: اِبْيَضَّتْ يَدِي يَا عَلِيٌّ، فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: وَاللَّهُ رَآهُ، وَاللَّهُ رَآهُ، وَاللَّهُ رَآهُ

translations.en: So I attended him at his death, and he stretched out his hand and said: 'My hand has brightened, O Ali!' I said: So I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) while Muhammad ibn Mas'un was with him. He said: When I rose from his presence, I thought that Muhammad would inform him of the news of the man, so he sent a messenger after me, and I returned to him. He said: Inform me about this man whom you attended at his death, what did you hear him say? I said: He stretched out his hand and said: 'My hand has brightened, O Ali!' So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: By Allah, he saw him! By Allah, he saw him! By Allah, he saw him!

en.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the high spiritual status of Zakariyya ibn Sabur, a companion of the Imams, whose declaration 'My hand has whitened' signifies the illumination of his soul or the vision of the Imam at the moment of death. Imam al-Sadiq’s triple affirmation 'By Allah, he saw him' underscores the Shia belief in the tangible spiritual presence of the Imam during the transition of the soul, linking physical death with metaphysical realization. The narrative serves as a testament to the piety and closeness of the Ahl al-Bayt's companions to the divine light.
en.seo_question: What did Zakariyya ibn Sabur say when he died, and what did the Imam confirm?

key_terms.ابْيَضَّتْ يَدِي: My hand has brightened (indicates seeing light/Imam at death)
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) (Imam al-Sadiq)
key_terms.رَآهُ: He saw him (referring to the Imam or divine light)
